2.2.9 RdlURL
The RdlURL type specifies a valid absolute URL. The value of this element MUST be a String
([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1) or an expression that evaluates to a String. The URL string or
expression MUST begin with one of the following:
http://

https://

ftp://

mailto:

news:

The RdlURL type can be referenced by the following elements.
Referenced by
Action.Hyperlink
BackgroundImage.Value
CapImage.Value
FrameImage.Value
GaugeImage.Value
Image.Value
MapMarkerImage.Value
PointerImage.Value
StateImage.Value
TopImage.Value
